Baruipur Rape-Murder Case: Arrests Made Amidst Protests and Accused Lynching

A 12-year-old girl was found raped and murdered in Baruipur, West Bengal, leading to violent protests and the lynching of a suspected accused by a mob. Police have arrested two individuals and detained three others in connection with the crime, forming a Special Investigating Team to probe the case. Prohibitory orders have been imposed in the area.
